summary.text: John Salvesen, who goes by Bongo, is the Republican nominee for Georgia's 5th Congressional District and was also the party's nominee in 2024, when he lost to Nikema Williams. Ballotpedia lists his career experience in the construction industry. Little other biographical information is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists his birthplace as Burbank, California; in his 2024 Candidate Connection survey he described himself as originally from South Jersey and said he has lived in Atlanta since 1994.
Ballotpedia lists a graduate degree from Santa Monica College in 1989 and career experience in the construction industry.
Was the Republican nominee in 2024, advancing from the May 21, 2024 primary unopposed and losing the general election to Williams, 14.3% to 85.7%.
Advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary for the 5th District.
